title: Align, Don't Blend: Orthogonal Supervision Disentanglement As the Key to Generalizable AI-Generated Image Detection
abstract: arXiv:2512.06746v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent advances in AI-Generated Image (AIGI) detection have largely focused on model architectures, loss design, and training strategies, while overlooking a more fundamental factor: how supervision is structured. Existing detectors typically train on benchmark-defined data that implicitly blends semantic and artifact signals, leaving supervision design unexplored. In this paper, we examine supervision structure through controlled experiments and show that such blended supervision is not merely suboptimal but fundamentally counterproductive. Replacing it with disentangled, orthogonal supervision - paired with inductively matched models - suffices to achieve strong cross-generator generalization. We formalize this as Orthogonal Supervision Disentanglement and instantiate it in AlignGemini, a two-branch detector in which a VLM receives purely semantic supervision and a vision expert receives purely artifact supervision. translated_title: 对齐而非混合：正交监督解耦是实现可泛化AI生成图像检测的关键
translated_abstract: 近期AI生成图像（AIGI）检测的进展主要集中在模型架构、损失函数设计和训练策略上，而忽略了一个更根本的因素：监督信号的组织结构。现有的检测器通常在基准定义的数据上训练，这些数据隐式地混合了语义信号和伪影信号，使得监督设计这一方向未被探索。在本文中，我们通过受控实验检验了监督结构，并表明这种混合监督不仅是次优的，而且在根本上是有害的。用解耦的正交监督来替代它——并配合归纳匹配的模型——就足以实现强大的跨生成器泛化能力。我们将这一方法形式化为正交监督解耦，并在AlignGemini中加以实例化，这是一个双分支检测器，其中视觉语言模型（VLM）接受纯语义监督，而视觉专家模型接受纯伪影监督。
tldr: 本文发现将语义与伪影信号混合的监督方式是AI生成图像检测的根本性障碍，提出正交监督解耦方法，通过让视觉语言模型专注语义、视觉专家专注伪影的双分支检测器AlignGemini，实现了强大的跨生成器泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that blended supervision is fundamentally counterproductive for AI-generated image detection, and proposes Orthogonal Supervision Disentanglement, instantiated in the two-branch AlignGemini detector where a VLM receives purely semantic supervision and a vision expert receives purely artifact supervision, achieving strong cross-generator generalization.
